title: Plasma proteome profiling reveals molecular mechanisms underlying the effects of daily consumption of 'Bahia' and 'Cara Cara' orange juices.
authors: Tobaruela, Eric de Castro; Brasili, Elisa; Zeraik, Laila; Milenkovic, Dragan; Hassimotto, Neuza Mariko Aymoto; Lajolo, Franco Maria
one_liner_zh: 该文通过血浆蛋白质组学分析橙汁消费对健康人蛋白表达的影响，并用分子对接预测黄烷酮代谢物与转录因子结合，但核心是营养干预而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: Orange juice is an important food source of bioactive compounds, mainly the flavanones hesperidin and narirutin. This study aimed to investigate the underlying molecular mechanisms of action of orange juice's health properties by analyzing changes in the plasma proteome of healthy Brazilian volunteers after consuming juices made from 'Bahia' (BOJ-source of flavanones) and 'Cara Cara' (CCOJ-source of flavanones and carotenoids) oranges cultivated in Brazil. We used an untargeted proteomic approach, with a particular emphasis on the juices' effects on blood coagulant activity. We identified 247 differentially expressed proteins, of which 170 significantly increased or decreased after BOJ consumption and 145 after CCOJ. These proteins are involved in 105 processes that can significantly regulate cell adhesion, cell signaling, cell metabolism, inflammation, or others. Bioinformatic analysis evidenced proteins with major cellular regulatory capacity (e.g., FN1 and GAPDH) and predicted transcription factors (TFs) (e.g., SP1 and CEBPA) and miRNAs (e.g., miR-1-3p and miR-615-3p) that could be involved in the regulation of differentially expressed proteins. In-silico docking analyses between flavanone metabolites and TFs evidenced the higher binding capacity of narirutin phase II metabolites with akt1 and p38, interactions that suggest how the expression of genes of differentially expressed proteins were activated or inhibited. Moreover, the study shed light on proteins of coagulation cascade that presented expression modulated by both juices, proposing the modulation of blood coagulant activity as a potential benefit of OJ (mainly CCOJ) consumption. Taken together, this study revealed that BOJ and CCOJ consumption affected plasma proteome in healthy individuals, suggesting potential molecular targets and mechanisms of OJ bioactive compounds in humans.
abstract_zh: 橙汁是生物活性化合物的重要食物来源，主要是黄烷酮类化合物橙皮苷和柚皮芸香苷。本研究旨在通过分析健康巴西志愿者在饮用产自巴西的‘Bahia’（BOJ—黄烷酮来源）和‘Cara Cara’（CCOJ—黄烷酮和类胡萝卜素来源）橙子制成的果汁后血浆蛋白质组的变化，探讨橙汁健康特性的潜在分子作用机制。我们采用非靶向蛋白质组学方法，特别关注果汁对血液凝血活性的影响。我们鉴定出247种差异表达蛋白，其中170种在BOJ饮用后显著上调或下调，145种在CCOJ饮用后发生显著变化。这些蛋白参与105个过程，可显著调节细胞黏附、细胞信号传导、细胞代谢、炎症等。生物信息学分析揭示了具有主要细胞调控能力的蛋白（如FN1和GAPDH），并预测了可能参与差异表达蛋白调控的转录因子（TFs）（如SP1和CEBPA）和miRNAs（如miR-1-3p和miR-615-3p）。黄烷酮代谢物与TFs之间的计算机模拟对接分析显示，柚皮芸香苷II相代谢物与akt1和p38具有更高的结合能力，这些相互作用提示了差异表达蛋白基因表达如何被激活或抑制。此外，该研究揭示了凝血级联反应中的蛋白，其表达受两种果汁调节，提出调节血液凝血活性可能是饮用橙汁（主要是CCOJ）的潜在益处。综合来看，本研究揭示BOJ和CCOJ的饮用影响了健康个体血浆蛋白质组，提示了橙汁生物活性化合物在人体中的潜在分子靶点和机制。
